name: PeopleConnect (Intelius)
instructions: Open https://suppression.peopleconnect.us/login and follow the site's steps for {full_name}. Use {contact_email} wherever it asks for an email address, so the reply is matched. Then press "I've done this".
notes: One suppression request covers the PeopleConnect brands: Intelius, TruthFinder, Instant Checkmate, US Search, ZabaSearch, Addresses.com, AddressSearch, PeopleLookup, LookupAnyone and PublicRecords.com (not Classmates). The site emails a code to the address given, then asks for a date of birth and legal name before showing records to pick; it may ask the person to complete a masked old email or phone. If it can't find the record, privacy@peopleconnect.us takes requests by email.
source: Process per redact.dev's Intelius/PeopleConnect removal guide (updated 2026-05-21). Brands covered per the parent-company catalog.
